This method refines the rigid transformation $\hat{T} \in SE(3)$ between two NeRF scenes (Scene A and Scene B) by minimizing photometric error on rays sampled from high-confidence regions [S1].

The claim states that the method refines a rigid transformation T in SE(3) between two NeRF scenes by minimizing photometric error on rays from high-confidence regions. All facts in the claim are present and supported by the evidence.
